integrity: The maximum, complete labeled count, orbit decomposition, stabilizer orders, representatives, and structural profiles are all recomputed from the definition by the bundled standalone verifier. The proof does not infer impossibility from a timeout, partial enumeration, or heuristic search.
limitations: Finite, computer-assisted equality classification for binary length seven; it does not generalize automatically to higher lengths. An exact primary full text for the Bevan source behind the OEIS small-dimensional witness was not located, leaving a residual historical-originality risk. Earlier 1995 Hamming-space literature was seen only with month-level publication metadata, so no invented day was assigned from it.
title: Equality classification for binary length-seven frameproof codes
